answer_1.quote: Despite many recent advances in Natural Language Generation, successful creative narrative composition remains elusive... we develop a novel system for story generation.

answer_2.quote: We use a combination of human and automatic metrics to evaluate all systems. Automatic metrics are evaluated on 1000 randomly selected prompts... We choose to focus on these metrics as indicative of performance... Vocab:Token Ratio... Entities per plot... inter-story trigram repetition... intra-story trigram repetition.

answer_4.quote: We have Mechanical Turk workers rate all systems' outputs on the same prompt comparatively on a likert score (1-5) across both metrics... Relevance is defined as whether stories both relate to the given prompt and remain on topic for the duration of the story. Overall Quality is defined to be combination of coherence, interestingness, and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Workers assigned Likert scores (1-5) for Relevance and Overall Quality based on comparative assessment of stories.
